text: (Independent expert confirmation) Anthem's Q1 ClaimsXten release changed PTP bypass behavior: plain modifier 59 is effectively dead at Anthem for therapy pairs; the engine wants specific X modifiers (XS for distinct structure) with a documentation pointer.
